newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends lower, fears of BOK sales affect.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends lower, fears of BOK sales affect.

text.p: South Korean won closed slightly lower against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday. but trading was slow on fears about the central bank's possible dollar sales, dealers said.
The won closed at 862.00 after opening at a high of 861.00. It touched a low of 863.00.
Brokers said the won opened strong on expectations that importer deals would increase later this week.
Fears over the central bank's dollar sales limited dollar buying. "Trading was slow because of fears about central bank intervention," said a domestic bank dealer.
Dealers said the local currency was expected to fall further on Thursday on the back of importer deals due later this week and early next week.
They saw the won's base mid-rate at 862.40 on Thursday, unchanged from Wednesday.
